extension.description: Practise writing a foreign language in VS Code. An LLM reviews your text; chunks and grammar points go straight into Anki.
view.name: Writing practice
config.nativeLanguage: Your native language. Used for generated source passages, explanations, and the front of Anki cards.
config.uiLanguage: Language used by OneWriter for messages, choices, and views. Auto follows your native language, then the VS Code display language.
config.targets: Languages you are practising. Each entry has a language and a level. Easier to edit through the "Switch language and level" command.
config.activeTarget: Which language to use when a file has no front matter.
config.practiceGlob: Which files count as practice texts. Only matching files get the review button.
config.llm.gemini.model: Gemini model used to review your writing.
config.llm.openai.model: OpenAI model used to review your writing.
config.llm.qwen.model: Qwen model used to review your writing.
config.llm.qwen.baseUrl: Base URL for the Qwen-compatible REST API.
config.llm.deepseek.model: DeepSeek model used to review your writing.
config.llm.claude.model: Claude model used to review your writing.
config.llm.timeoutMs: Maximum wait for one review, in milliseconds. Defaults to 300000 (5 minutes) for long writing exercises.
config.llm.maxChunks: Maximum number of chunks the model may suggest per text.
config.llm.promptTemplate: Your own prompt, replacing the built-in one. Leave empty for the default. Variables: {nativeLang} {targetLang} {level} {style} {levelPolicy} {maxChunks} {explanationLanguage} {schema} {topic} {text}.
config.review.showBetter: Also show places that are correct but could be phrased better.
config.anki.url: AnkiConnect address. Anki desktop must be running.
config.anki.modelName: Note type name. Created automatically if missing.
config.anki.tags: Tags added to every card created.
config.anki.skipDuplicates: Leave chunks already in the deck unselected.
